description: This source file manages temporary files, including creation, cleanup, signal handling, and lifecycle management within a software project. It maintains a linked list of tempfile objects, handles cleanup on exit or signals, and provides functions to create, open, close, rename, and delete temporary files with appropriate permissions and error handling.

classes.name: tempfile
classes.description: A structure representing a temporary file, including its metadata, file descriptor, associatedFILE pointer, owner PID, filename, and optional directory.

methods.name: int remove_template_directory(struct tempfile * tempfile,int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, handling signal context.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles(int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes all active temporary files owned by the current process, called during cleanup.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_exit(void)
methods.description: Wrapper to cleanup tempfiles on program exit.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_signal(int signo)
methods.description: Handles cleanup of tempfiles in response to signals.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * new_tempfile(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile structure.

methods.name: void activate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Adds a tempfile to the global list and sets process ownership, also initializes signal handlers on first call.

methods.name: void deactivate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Removes a tempfile from the global list and deallocates its resources.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile_mode(const char * path,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with specified mode and path.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * register_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Registers a tempfile with a given path.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_sm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a named temporary file with given filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tsm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a named temporary file in /tmp or environment-specified directory with given template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_dt(const char * directory_template,const char * filename)
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a file inside, using a template.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with robust error handling based on filename template and mode.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile,const char * mode)
methods.description: Associates a FILE* stream with the tempfile's file descriptor.

methods.name: const char * get_tempfile_path(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the filename of the tempfile.

methods.name: int get_tempfile_fd(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_tempfile_fp(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the FILE* pointer associated with the tempfile.

methods.name: int close_tempfile_gently(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE*, if open, without deleting the file.

methods.name: int reopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Reopens a tempfile for writing, after it has been closed.

methods.name: int rename_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames a tempfile to a specified path, closing it first.

methods.name: int delete_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p)
methods.description: Deletes the tempfile, closing and unlinking the file, and removing its directory if applicable.
